rule.source: Parakeet word transcript (output.json chunks[].timestamp) of the exported output.wav inside [0, T_input]; annotations copied into each sample dir

pause_handling.transcribed_speech_in_pause_s: sum over words of |[word_start, word_end] ∩ [pause_start, pause_end]| over all annotated [PAUSE] windows
pause_handling.words_starting_in_pause: count of words with pause_start <= word_start <= pause_end for some pause
pause_handling.pauses_with_word_start: annotated pause windows containing at least one word start
pause_handling.official_tor: transcript span (last word end - first word start) >= 1 s OR more than 3 words (eval_pause_handling.py)
pause_handling.transcribed_speech_before_first_pause_s: sum over words of |[word_start, word_end] ∩ [0, first annotated pause start]|: model speech before the user has paused at all (unprompted / overlapping)
pause_handling.outside_pause_placement: a word starting outside every pause is 'spill_after_pause_end' if it starts <= 1.0 s after a pause end, else 'lead_in_before_pause_start' if <= 1.0 s before a pause start, else 'far_from_pauses' (the user is speaking continuously there); its seconds exclude any part inside a pause

turn_taking.latency_signed_vs_last_word_end_s: first transcribed word start - annotated last user word END; signed, not clamped; all sessions with >= 1 word
turn_taking.official_latency_s: max(0, first word start - annotated last user word START), TOR sessions only (eval_smooth_turn_taking.py)
turn_taking.first_word_after_last_word_end_s: start of the first word that begins at or after the last-word end, minus the last-word end (ignores words spoken while the user was still talking)
turn_taking.transcribed_speech_before_last_word_end_: sum over words of |[word_start, word_end] ∩ [0, last_word_end]|

rule.word_end_none: a word with a null end timestamp is treated as zero-length at its start (none occur in these trees)
